player_prompt.intro:
Uwite Player {player_id} mu mukino wa GameOfPureStrategy.
- Ushaka kaari 13 zozi zitwa A-K; zishobora kugwanishwa mara kimwe.
- Kuva mu mukururuko, kaari ya prize itabonwa. Shyiramo kaari moja kwa kandika kitu gikenewe n'agaciro gahimbwe kama '[Q]', '[10]', '[2]' ...
- Kaari eka k'ijana itwara irihare (pamo na kugabanuka). Imikino itahimbwa hadi irihare rikururutse mu mukururuko urubyiri.
- Jyeni ryo hejuru nyinshi nyinshi ba nyuma ya mukururuko 13.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Igikorwa kigomba kuba kirimo ikarita imwe gusa ifite indangamanota.
invalid_move.card_not_held: You no longer have that card.
